the briefing names no relay into another agent, tenant or policy domain, and the A2A path is a separate route (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1770).","RH":"The stored instruction is a self-referential directive that the agent is documented to follow and re-store (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:636-643, 654-657), so a proxy/instruction channel is reachable, but no human-verified reward-hacking episode is reported in the briefing.","ES":"The documented path uses no dynamic extension: MemoryBot's declared tools are read_file, write_file and search (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:632-679) and the sink is a fixed in-process list, so no unvetted tool, MCP server or plugin is on the path.","CVSS":"Unauthenticated network reach to the agent port (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1396-1400, 1561-1564) with no user interaction;
